items.title: When Speaking Up Feels Dangerous: We Need Community More Than Ever
items.description:
When Speaking Up Feels Dangerous: We Need Community More Than Ever
There was a time when many of us working for diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, belonging and human rights worried primarily about whether our organizations were moving quickly enough. Today, some of us are asking a much more fundamental question: Is it safe to speak up at all?
